subject: Targeted access-recert & auth-log slices needed for SOC 2 Type II review
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Leigh <marcus.leigh@northridgehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Targeted access-recert & auth-log slices needed for SOC 2 Type II review

Hi Marcus —

Thanks again for the quick SOC 2 packet delivery last week. As the auditor team finishes the Type II review, they asked for a few targeted control artifacts beyond the report to verify operation of controls in scope. Can you confirm whether Northridge can provide the following by Friday, Jul 8? If the timeline is tight we can negotiate a short extension but would like to lock in expectations.

Requested artifacts (short description):
- MFA exception log slice: all MFA bypass/exception events for 2027-05-01 through 2027-05-31 (fields: user id, event timestamp, reason code, approver id)
- Access recertification evidence: export of the most recent monthly recertification (CSV with user, group, recertifier, decision, timestamp)
- Session/token extract: 3 sample user traces (token issue, refresh, revocation events) covering a contiguous 72-hour window — redacted PII is fine if a clear pseudonym mapping is provided out-of-band
- Confirmation of retention window for auth logs (policy pointer or short statement)

I attached an evidence-matrix-template.xlsx to help map items back to SOC 2 criteria (attachment stub). Delivery options: secure GDrive folder (redwood link) or SFTP drop — whichever your security team prefers.

Please also confirm whether you can supply a short bridge letter that certifies the audit period and whether any compensating controls were in effect for May 2027. A one-paragraph bridge letter is usually sufficient for the auditor.

Let me know who on your side will own the delivery and whether you have any questions about formats or anonymization.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: evidence-matrix-template.xlsx (stub)

From: Marcus Leigh <marcus.leigh@northridgehealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 14:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Targeted access-recert & auth-log slices needed for SOC 2 Type II review

Laura —

Appreciate the clear list. We can get most of this together but a couple clarifying questions from my security lead:

1) Pseudonymization: we prefer to mask user identifiers (e.g., uid -> U###) and provide a mapping via our secure portal to auditors only. Is that acceptable?
2) Delivery: we can upload to an SFTP share or push to a dedicated GDrive folder with restricted access. If you prefer Drive, can you share the specific folder and the account to grant access to?

Also, the bridge letter — we can provide a short letter. Would Redwood prefer a simple confirmation of audit period and no exceptions, or should we describe the scoped exceptions (if any) in-line?

I can own assembly and delivery. Targeting Jul 6 for a first drop — does that work?

Thanks,
Marcus Leigh
Security Operations Manager
Northridge Health
marcus.leigh@northridgehealth.com

Attachment: org-security-policy.pdf (requested by auditor)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Leigh <marcus.leigh@northridgehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Targeted access-recert & auth-log slices needed for SOC 2 Type II review

Hi Marcus —

All good answers — pseudonymization is acceptable as long as the auditor team can map back if needed. A couple more details from the audit side: they asked that

- MFA exception slice include the approver email or id (pseudonymized consistently) and a short free-text reason where available;
- For the session/token extract please include event types (issue, refresh, revoke), client_id, and ip address (can be truncated to /24 if needed for privacy);
- For access recertification, auditors want the recertifier identity and the timestamp of the recertification action (CSV).

Delivery: please upload to the Google Drive link below and share it with auditing@redwood.ai (we will restrict access internally). If SFTP is easier for your team, we can provide credentials and a checksum method.

Drive link (create folder and share): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSECURE-evidence-share

Bridge letter: a single paragraph confirming the audit window (May 1 — May 31, 2027) and whether any control exceptions existed during that period is perfect. If you have compensating controls to call out, include them briefly. We have a draft bridge-letter template we can share after we receive your drop.

Thanks for owning this — if Jul 6 works that will give the auditors enough runway to validate before they close the engagement.

Best,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Targeted access-recert & auth-log slices needed for SOC 2 Type II review

Marcus —

Thanks for taking this on. Confirming Jul 6 as the delivery target is fine. Two quick asks before you upload:

1) Please include a short README.txt in the drop that lists pseudonymization rules and the column layout for each CSV/extract.
2) If you provide IPs truncated to /24, note that in the README so auditors understand the transformation.

I'll attach a bridge-letter-draft.pdf (internal draft) for your reference — feel free to adapt. If you share the Drive folder URL once created we will validate access and let you know.

-Rishi
Director, Applied Security
Redwood Inference
